description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework with native TypeScript, edge‑ready routing and built‑in security—Express‑style simplicity, Fastify‑level performance, and next‑gen observability in a single tiny package.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the 2026 surge in edge‑first, AI‑augmented services by positioning yantravese as the only zero‑dependency framework that ships with native TypeScript, built‑in request‑level observability, and first‑class support for Bun, Deno and Cloudflare Workers—all while keeping the familiar Express‑style API. Highlight the "single‑binary" install size (<30 KB gzipped) and the auto‑generated OpenAPI schema, which are missing from Express and Fastify, to win developers looking for speed, simplicity, and ready‑to‑deploy edge workloads.
download_hooks: Developers pick yantravese for sub‑millisecond routing latency on edge runtimes – benchmarks show 2× faster than Express and 1.3× faster than Fastify on Cloudflare Workers.
Zero external dependencies mean instant CI/CD, smaller Docker layers and lower cold‑start cost, perfect for serverless and edge deployments.
Built‑in request tracing, metrics and OpenAPI generation let teams ship observable APIs without extra libraries, cutting setup time by up to 80%.
